Throughout his internship, Ayaan demonstrated adaptability, insight, and a strong work ethic, often asking thoughtful questions that surpassed those of many experienced/ graduate interns. His ability to grasp intricate valuation excercises and connect various financial concepts impressed me and my colleagues greatly. In summary, Ayaan is a dedicated and talented individual, and I highly recommend him for any future opportunities. If he was a graduate, I would have gladly asked him to apply to our department. ”

honors_and_awards.title: Overall Winner @Microsoft (HackWithBay)
honors_and_awards.description: We built an AI M&A Analyst — a digital junior investment banker for due diligence: • Landing AI parsed SEC Regulation S-K Item 601 filings and earnings PDFs, surfacing anomalies and missing disclosures. • Pathway AI powered a RAG system that cross-referenced contracts, flagged risks, and reduced review cycles from weeks to hours. • Teams could collaborate in a shared workspace, making diligence faster, sharper, and more reliable.
